description: This file defines Express routes for handling CRUD operations related to pain tracking, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting pain entries. It also includes Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/', requireAuth, (req, res) => { listPain(req, res); })
methods.description: Route handler for listing pain entries.

methods.name: router.post('/', requireAuth, (req, res) => { createPain(req, res); })
methods.description: Route handler for creating a new pain entry.

methods.name: router.get('/:id', requireAuth, (req, res) => { getPain(req, res); })
methods.description: Route handler for retrieving a specific pain entry by ID.

methods.name: router.put('/:id', requireAuth, (req, res) => { updatePain(req, res); })
methods.description: Route handler for updating a pain entry by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, (req, res) => { deletePain(req, res); })
methods.description: Route handler for deleting a pain entry by ID.
